results.question: Which trades over $1M failed to settle this week, by counterparty?
results.sql:
SELECT c.counterparty_name, COUNT(*) AS trades_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_SETTLEMENTS s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_COUNTERPARTY c ON c.counterparty_id = t.counterparty_id
WHERE s.settlement_status = 'FAILED'
  AND t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND t.notional_usd > 1000000
  AND s.expected_settle_date BETWEEN '2026-11-16' AND '2026-11-20'
GROUP BY c.counterparty_name
ORDER BY trades_count DESC

results.question: How many trades failed to settle yesterday?

results.question: List all failed trades with their fail reason
results.sql:
SELECT t.trade_id, t.trade_date, x.ticker, t.side, t.notional_usd, c.counterparty_name, s.expected_settle_date, s.settlement_status, s.fail_reason, s.days_failing
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_SETTLEMENTS s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_COUNTERPARTY c ON c.counterparty_id = t.counterparty_id
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_SECURITY x ON x.security_id = t.security_id
WHERE s.settlement_status = 'FAILED'
  AND t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'

results.question: What is the total notional of failed trades by fail reason?
results.sql:

WHERE s.settlement_status = 'FAILED'

ORDER BY total_notional_usd DESC

results.question: What percentage of trades due this month settled on time?

FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_SETTLEMENTS s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND s.expected_settle_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-20'
